name: Civil Engineering
description: Civil engineering programmes teach the analysis and design of the built environment — structures, foundations, transportation, water supply, drainage and coastal works — together with the public responsibility that comes with putting a seal on the drawings.
degreesNote: A Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it; at several Florida institutions the same department also awards an environmental engineering degree. ⚠ This is the discipline where the PROFESSIONAL ENGINEER licence matters most: public works and most structural design must be sealed by a licensed engineer, so the degree needs to come from a programme accredited by ABET’s ENGINEERING commission. A civil engineering TECHNOLOGY degree leads to technician, surveying and inspection work and carries a longer experience requirement before licensure — which bites harder here than in any other discipline, because in civil practice the licence is close to mandatory rather than optional.

cips.note: Civil Engineering — the degree itself. Nine Florida public institutions award it, from bachelor’s through doctorate, with post-baccalaureate certificates at three of them for practising engineers adding a speciality.

related.note: ⚠ Usually the same department and often the same first two years. Water and wastewater, stormwater and remediation sit on the environmental side; if that is the part of civil that interests you, check whether your institution awards the separate degree or an emphasis inside civil.

Coastal structures, ports, beach nourishment and storm surge — which in Florida is a large share of the civil work there is. ⚠ Only one public institution awards the ocean bachelor’s, so the normal route is a civil degree followed by coastal specialisation.

⚠ The adjacent route, and the one to understand clearly here: civil engineering TECHNOLOGY leads to surveying, inspection and construction work rather than to sealed design. Because the PE licence is close to mandatory in civil practice, the longer experience requirement it carries bites harder in this discipline than in any other.
